name: Celestial Bond Gemstone Bracelet Set
materials: Amethyst, sodalite, moonstone, crystal, topaz, fresh water pearl, Czech glass, spinel, smoky quartz, aquamarine; gold tone, 14/20 gold filled spacers and findings; infinity clasp with a small star charm
description:
ACOTAR inspired Feyre and Rhysand two-bracelet set brings Light and Shadow together on one shared infinity clasp.

Moonstone recalls Feyre's first visit to the Moonstone Palace. Luminous pearls, pale blue and blush tones reflect her softer side, while deep navy, smoky, black and violet beads evoke Rhysand and the Night Court. The arrow honors Feyre's strength as a huntress, and the star charm is a nod to Velaris and Starfall. The mountain with night sky honors Remiel, the blood rite and the Night Court. The infinity clasp symbolizes a bond with no beginning or end.

Designed to be worn together as one layered piece, these bracelets celebrate two distinct strands. Joined by one lasting connection.

Bead color may vary due to natural gemstone selection.

Made by hand; slight variations in bead color and placement can vary based on size.
